title: Evening Round: when does the next voice come in?
intro: This melody is a round for three voices. Find how long each voice waits before coming in. Set 'Entry every' and press Check.
source: Written for Canon Workbench as a practice piece.
hints: Rounds usually bring voices in at the start of a phrase.
Look for where the melody changes character: long notes, then quarter notes, then movement.
Each phrase is the same length. How many bars is the first one?
